stories.headline: OpenAI's Astra Solves Ten Open Math Problems for About $2,000
stories.key_takeaway: An internal version of OpenAI's unreleased Astra model produced ten Lean-verified solutions to long-open math problems for roughly $2,000 in compute, though the results cluster in AI-friendly areas and fall well short of AGI.

pull_quote.text: We didn't spend a lot on each problem. It's possible to push test-time compute much further.

data_points.label: Years a key question stood open

stories.article_excerpt: For roughly the price of a used car, an artificial intelligence appears to have moved the frontier of pure mathematics.

stories.headline: AI Coding Agents Modernize Research Software With Speedups Up to 60x
stories.key_takeaway: AI coding agents modernized neglected research software with speedups up to 60x, but a report from OpenAI and academic partners warns the agents cannot verify scientific correctness, keeping human oversight essential.

pull_quote.text: With coding agents, it's quite easy to go fast; for now, to go far in science, there's still a need for expert guidance, understanding, taste, and care.
pull_quote.role: Developer of the genomics library cyvcf2

stories.article_excerpt: A quality-control pipeline that once took more than 15 hours to grind through a large genomics dataset now finishes in minutes.

stories.headline: DeepMind's 'Prospective Credit Assignment' Sharpens Long-Horizon Coding Agents
stories.key_takeaway: DeepMind's prospective credit assignment trains models to anticipate the downstream impact of each decision, reportedly boosting SWE-Bench success on issues that take more than 10 steps to resolve.

pull_quote.text: Software engineering assistants tackling SWE-bench issues routinely execute 50-100+ turns consuming 100K-500K tokens.
pull_quote.attribution: Credit Assignment in RL for LLMs

stories.article_excerpt: When a coding agent is handed a real GitHub issue in a sprawling codebase, the hard part is rarely the first move.

stories.headline: ICML 2026's Most-Cited Efficiency Result: 'Selective Activation Sparsity' Rivals Models 3x Its Size
stories.key_takeaway: An ICML 2026 method called selective activation sparsity reportedly lets models match rivals three times their size on reasoning benchmarks, pointing to major training and inference savings.

pull_quote.text: If this approach proves scalable, it has significant implications for the cost of both training and inference, and for running capable AI models on devices with limited compute.

stories.article_excerpt: A single training trick is generating more buzz at this year's machine learning conference than most new models.

stories.headline: Nvidia Details Vera, Its Next-Generation AI Data-Center CPU
stories.key_takeaway: Nvidia published detailed Vera CPU specs and shipped first units to top AI labs, escalating its bid to take data-center CPU share from AMD and Intel through full-stack lock-in.

pull_quote.text: Agentic AI is creating a new CPU moment in the AI factory; as models move from answering to acting, Vera is purpose-built to keep that work moving at scale.
pull_quote.role: VP of Hyperscale and HPC, Nvidia

stories.article_excerpt: Nvidia has spent a decade convincing the world the GPU is the heart of the AI data center. Now it wants the CPU too.

stories.headline: Google Cancels Its AI Studio Mobile App, Folding Creation Tools Into Gemini
stories.key_takeaway: Google scrapped its planned standalone AI Studio mobile app despite 800,000-plus preorders, folding app creation into Gemini as it consolidates consumer AI around a single surface.

pull_quote.text: Instead of asking you to download yet another app we've decided to take an entirely different approach: one where apps emerge naturally, in the course of your everyday conversations with Gemini.

stories.article_excerpt: Google has killed a mobile app that hundreds of thousands of people had already lined up to download.

stories.headline: Prime Intellect Raises $130 Million to Help Enterprises Build Their Own AI Agents
stories.key_takeaway: Prime Intellect raised a $130M Series A at a roughly $1B valuation to sell enterprises a full-stack platform for training their own AI agents instead of depending on closed frontier labs.

pull_quote.text: It shouldn't just be a few nerds in a glass tower in San Francisco that have the capability to train AI models. It should be every enterprise, every nation state.

stories.article_excerpt: Prime Intellect is betting that any company should be able to train its own AI rather than rent intelligence from a few labs.

stories.headline: Palo Alto's Unit 42 Uncovers an Attacker Who Wired DeepSeek Into an Autonomous Hacking Agent
stories.key_takeaway: An attacker wired the open-weight DeepSeek model into an off-the-shelf agent framework and ran an end-to-end autonomous offensive workflow against 460-plus systems, showing how self-hosted models route around vendor safety controls.

pull_quote.text: While the observed campaign had limited impacts, the workflow confirms a functional, end-to-end autonomous offensive capability.

stories.article_excerpt: A lone attacker wired a freely downloadable AI model into an off-the-shelf agent framework and pointed it at the open internet.

stories.headline: Arrakis Exits Stealth With $30 Million to Put AI Agents Into Industrial Operations
stories.key_takeaway: Arrakis raised a $30M Series A (roughly $38M total) to embed outcome-priced AI agents into the mission-critical operations of energy, logistics, aerospace and manufacturing firms.

pull_quote.text: Most AI investment to date has targeted the 30% of workers behind a desk. The real ROI lies in the 70% running industrial operations.

stories.article_excerpt: For two years, the money and mythology of AI have chased the knowledge worker. Arrakis is betting on the factory floor.

stories.headline: TerraFirma Lands $100 Million to Bring AI and Autonomous Robots to Construction
stories.key_takeaway: TerraFirma, founded by ex-SpaceX engineers, raised $100 million led by Kleiner Perkins to scale AI software and semi-autonomous heavy machinery aimed at construction's productivity decline and labor shortage.

pull_quote.text: It is not about trying to fully automate construction equipment. Driving real change requires building a whole ecosystem of technology directly informed by lessons from the field.

stories.article_excerpt: A pair of former SpaceX engineers want to point the same first-principles thinking at the construction site.

stories.headline: Abu Dhabi's MGX Closes Its First Fund at $49 Billion for AI Infrastructure Bets
stories.key_takeaway: Abu Dhabi's MGX closed its first fund at $49 billion, exceeding its $45 billion target and cementing Gulf sovereign capital as a primary financier of the global AI infrastructure buildout.

pull_quote.text: Fund I is designed to give investors access to opportunities across the AI technology stack, including areas where access may be limited.

stories.article_excerpt: Abu Dhabi has just written one of the largest checks in the history of artificial intelligence.

stories.headline: LeapXpert Raises $180 Million to Scale Governed AI Communications in Finance
stories.key_takeaway: LeapXpert raised $180 million led by Riverwood Capital to expand its platform that lets regulated firms use consumer messaging apps compliantly and apply AI to those governed conversations.

pull_quote.text: Messaging is where business happens now. The next wave of enterprise value will come from making those conversations trusted, connected, and actionable.

stories.article_excerpt: LeapXpert helps regulated businesses use consumer messaging apps without falling foul of the compliance rulebook.

stories.headline: Microsoft Commits $10 Billion to Expand AI and Cloud Capacity in Japan
stories.key_takeaway: Microsoft's roughly $10 billion, 2026-2029 commitment to Japanese AI infrastructure, cybersecurity and skilling is its largest-ever bet on Japan and a defensive move amid a hyperscaler capex race.

pull_quote.text: This investment is a response to Japan's growing need for cloud and AI services.

stories.article_excerpt: Microsoft is placing its biggest-ever bet on Japan, committing roughly $10 billion to expand its AI and cloud footprint.

stories.headline: Trump Media Launches a Paid Data API, and Senators Demand an SEC Probe
stories.key_takeaway: Trump Media's new Truth API sells trading firms millisecond-fast access to the president's market-moving posts, prompting Democratic senators to request an SEC investigation into fairness and manipulation concerns.

pull_quote.text: Trump Media's new data feed product is designed to work in the best interest of only a small few people: President Trump, his family, wealthy insiders, and high-frequency traders on Wall Street.
pull_quote.role: U.S. Senators, in a letter to the SEC

stories.article_excerpt: On August 1, Trump Media turned the president's social feed into a product for Wall Street's fastest traders.

stories.headline: California's AI Transparency Act Takes Effect, Mandating Content Provenance
stories.key_takeaway: California's SB 942 is now the first live U.S. law forcing large generative-AI providers to embed C2PA-style provenance and offer free detection tools, even as a December 2025 federal order threatens to challenge it.

pull_quote.text: It is crucial that consumers have the right to know if a product has been generated by AI.
pull_quote.role: California State Senator and author of SB 942

stories.article_excerpt: California became the first state to force the largest AI companies to label their machine-made images, video and audio.

stories.headline: The EU AI Act's Transparency and GPAI Rules Begin Enforcement on August 2
stories.key_takeaway: On August 2, 2026 the EU began enforcing GPAI oversight, governance penalties and new AI transparency rules, while the Digital Omnibus deferred the most burdensome high-risk obligations to 2027 and 2028.

pull_quote.text: New transparency rules will start to apply, requiring certain AI systems to tell users when they are interacting with AI and when content has been generated or altered by it.

stories.article_excerpt: On August 2, 2026, the European Union stopped asking nicely and began enforcing key parts of its AI Act.
